reference.title: Structuring Your Email Inbox
reference.shortdesc: Example files used to filter incoming emails and reduce overwhelming notifications.

section.title: File Structures
section.p: Using structured files can reduce the clutter in your email inbox and help bring your attention to the content and urgency of each email while reducing alert fatigue The following examples are only a few structures to consider.

strow.stentry: Action folder, Awaiting Reply folder, Reference folder, To Read folder
Organizes emails into what you must do and how you can act; encourages you to actively sort through and acknowledge priority notifications.
Projects folder, Areas folder, Resources folder, Archives folder
Organizes emails into a simple and accessible hierarchy for working through short- and long-term assignments while clearing room for immediate alerts.
Custom folders with AI-assisted filters and purposes
Organizes emails into custom folders using AI-assisted filters scanning for specific keywords, email size, subject matter, and sender.
